purpose: Determine what one current Korean banner schedule row represents, without finalizing bannerId, bannerType, canonical definition schema, or relation schema.

rowGrainDecision.meaning: One record represents one banner/summon item displayed for one Korean schedule date and display position. It is an occurrence/display row, not a unique canonical banner definition.
rowGrainDecision.importantBoundary: sourceRecordKey/cardPool identity and the dated Korean occurrence row are different data units and must not be collapsed into one canonical identifier.

evidence.conclusion: Multiple dated Korean rows can point to the same CardPool source record. Therefore a schedule row cannot be the CardPool/banner definition itself.

examples.meaning: A source that originated as a new single-hero pool is displayed as a single rerun occurrence.
The same source pool can produce another later single-rerun occurrence row.

evidence.conclusion: sourceType describes source-pool origin/classification while scheduleType can describe Korean occurrence/display behavior. They must remain separate during Stage 1.
A valid Korean occurrence row can exist without a numeric bannerCode or CardPool sourceRecordKey. Occurrence identity therefore cannot depend on either field being non-null.

evidence.knownFact: The current validator checks 94 total records and verifies no duplicate displayOrder within the same krDisplayDate.
evidence.conclusion: krDisplayDate plus displayOrder are presentation/occurrence coordinates, not source definition identity.

sourceConflicts.decision: Do not auto-correct in Stage 1-2. Preserve as SOURCE_CONFLICT and require explicit relation correction/validation in Stage 1-4 or a dedicated repair step before production consumers.

rowClasses.definition: Dated display row with sourceRecordKey and usually bannerCode.
Dated display row managed manually and allowed to have null sourceRecordKey/bannerCode.
Dated display row whose recorded source linkage conflicts with raw ConfigData evidence.

notDecided: Whether bannerCode becomes any canonical key
Definition-to-occurrence cardinality beyond the verified many-occurrences-to-one-source example
Whether source CardPool records need a separate normalized bannerDefinition layer
Full sourceRecordKey correctness across all 94 rows

stage1_2Completion.reasonRawLinkageNotExhaustive: Stage 1-2 classifies row grain. Full relation correctness belongs to Stage 1-4. A representative raw crosscheck was sufficient to confirm grain and exposed one explicit source conflict.

consume: Treat every current kr-banner-schedule record as an occurrence/display row.
Keep MANUAL occurrences valid without sourceRecordKey/bannerCode.
Carry kr-banner:20270331:4 forward as SOURCE_CONFLICT; do not silently repair it.
